question: Must provisional child images also be prepared for the retinue deities?
premises: The main deities require provisional child images.
Retinue deities are part of the ritual complex.
The same procedure applies to them.
inference: In the same way, a provisional child image should be prepared for the retinue as well.
plain_english: Likewise, one should prepare a provisional child image for the retinue deities as well.
